messages:
Lucy P: Hey team — quick onboarding snag. I installed Zoom and tried to join an internal demo but macOS blocked screen sharing. System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Screen Recording shows Zoom unchecked and greyed out with note 'managed by your organization'. When I try to grant it there's a toast that disappears. Anyone know the Jamf flow for PPPC rules?

Omar (IT): welcome Lucy! Yes, Jamf can push a PPPC (Privacy Preferences Policy Control) profile to pre-approve screen recording for specific binaries. Which Zoom build path are you using (App Store or direct)? Also paste `spctl -a -vv /Applications/zoom.us.app` output if you can.

Lucy P: direct download from zoom.us; spctl output shows `accepted: source=Developer ID` so it's signed. The UI still says 'managed by your organization' so I think a PPPC or a consent dialog block is in place.

Omar (IT): can do. Two options: 1) we push a PPPC profile that allows screen recording for /Applications/zoom.us.app and Terminal (if you use screenrecord CLI). 2) If you prefer, we can open a temporary admin session so you can grant consent interactively (not recommended). We normally push PPPC.

Lydia (People Ops): IT push is fine — standard onboarding. Omar please log the change. Lucy, if you need admin for >1 hour file an it-help ticket.

Jonah (Security): Security prefers explicit PPPC entries that enumerate executable code signatures and identifiers, not blanket allowlists. Omar please scope the profile to Zoom's team ID.

Lucy P: thanks. Not in a rush — Zoom for meetings in 2 hours, would be great if the PPPC can go out now. My hardware UUID is 0fedcba9-8765-4321-0fed-cba987654321.

Jamf Bot: Policy "PPPC Allow Zoom Screen Recording (scoped)" queued for device 0fedcba9-8765-4321-0fed-cba987654321. Estimated completion: ~3 minutes.

Omar (IT): pushed a scoped PPPC profile allowing screen recording for Zoom (team ID: 67A8B2-EXAMPLE-TID) and Terminal. Please quit and restart Zoom, then rejoin the meeting; the permission should be granted without the dialog.

Lucy P: restarted Zoom and joined the test meeting — screen sharing works now! Thank you both :raised_hands: 

Jonah (Security): logged the policy id in the security tracker. Lucy, if you ever see a managed block again DM security instead of posting keys or logs here.

Lydia (People Ops): welcome aboard Lucy! Glad the demo works.

Lucy P: all set, closing this thread. :)
